title: Crosscurrent
pitch: Place a stone, shift its row or column, and build the strongest connected groups.

title: Gnomon
pitch: Stand uphill. Cast the shadow. A sun circles the board, every stone casts a shadow, and a stone caught in an enemy's shadow is gone.

title: Sever
pitch: A game of vanishing paths. Step through a hex-shaped network, then cut a thread behind you. Leave your rival with nowhere to go.

title: Longway
pitch: Two players extend one shared route across a hex board. Save your only vault, and leave the last way out for yourself.

title: Warp & Weft
pitch: One shuttle, two directions. Weft may only slide it sideways, Warp only up and down, and every number you take decides the one line your opponent gets to choose from.
